subject: Define own "family" and multivariate marginal distributions

messages.author: 9abd103965b46741
messages.subject: Define own "family" and multivariate marginal distributions
parts:
Hello,

is it possible in the INLA R-package to define an own "family" including its likelihood to use it? 
Furthermore, is it possible to use/to impelement e.g. bivariate marginal distributions which can be specified by "family"?
This would increase the flexbility of this package even more. Maybe I missed it.

Best, 
Peter

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Define own "family" and multivariate marginal distributions

You can add your own f()-model, ie Gaussian, but not (yet) a likelihood.
You have to requets one to be added if you need one that is not in the
list,
